claims: Attempted manslaughter is recognized in Hawaii.
Attempted murder requires specific intent to kill.
In April 2026, a doctor was found guilty of attempted manslaughter in Hawaii.
A doctor attempted to kill his wife by attacking her on a hiking trail.
The attempted manslaughter charge was reduced from a higher charge.
A YouTube video by Ksat News confirms the Hawaii doctor case.
18 U.S. Code § 1113 covers federal special maritime and territorial jurisdiction.
Under 18 U.S. Code § 1113, an attempt to commit manslaughter can lead to imprisonment for not more than seven years.
Hawaii's statute allows for up to 20 years for attempted manslaughter.
